sections.value: KlingAI Avatar 2.0 Standard is an audio-driven avatar video model that turns a single portrait image into a talking video. It is designed for fast, cost-efficient avatar generation while still keeping identity stable, lip-sync natural, and facial motion expressive enough for everyday production use. This Standard tier is a practical choice for teams that need scalable talking-head generation for content, support, education, or internal communication.

- Generates talking avatar videos from one source image and one audio track
- Produces synchronized lip movement based on speech timing and phonetic cues
- Adds subtle head, face, and upper-body motion for more natural delivery
- Supports human portraits, stylized characters, and cartoon-style avatars
- Allows an optional text prompt to steer tone, emotion, or presentation style
- Supports multilingual spoken content when the audio is clear and well-paced
- Suitable for both short social clips and longer presenter-style videos

The model combines three possible inputs:

1. Image input
A single portrait or character image defines the avatar's visual identity.

2. Audio input
A spoken audio file drives lip-sync timing, facial motion, and overall performance rhythm.

3. Optional prompt
A short text instruction can influence emotion, delivery style, or presentation feel.

After submission, the system aligns facial landmarks and speech timing internally, then synthesizes a video in which the avatar speaks with synchronized mouth motion and lightweight expressive movement. Output duration generally follows the length of the audio track.

Compared with KlingAI Avatar 2.0 Pro, the Standard version is positioned for efficiency and throughput. It is generally better suited to rapid iteration, higher-volume generation, and cost-sensitive workflows. Pro typically aims for stronger visual fidelity, smoother motion polish, and more refined expressive detail, while Standard focuses on keeping results reliable, usable, and economical for common avatar production needs.

- AI presenters for product walkthroughs or onboarding videos
- Voice-driven explainers and narrated tutorials
- Internal company announcements and update videos
- Customer support or FAQ avatar responses
- Educational lessons with a consistent virtual spokesperson
- Social media clips with a branded character or talking host
- Lightweight localization workflows by reusing the same image with different audio tracks

Image requirements:
- Use a clear front-facing or near-front-facing portrait
- Keep the face visible and well-lit
- Avoid heavy occlusion such as hands, microphones, masks, or large accessories blocking the mouth
- Minimum image size should meet provider constraints; a higher-quality source image usually improves stability
- Realistic portraits, stylized illustrations, and cartoon avatars are all supported

Audio requirements:
- Spoken audio is required for best results
- Cleaner recordings produce better lip-sync and expression timing
- Avoid heavy background noise, clipping, or overlapping speakers
- Keep pacing natural; extremely rushed speech may reduce clarity of animation
- Output length is typically tied to the audio duration

Optional prompt:
- Use a short prompt only when you want to bias delivery style, such as calm, enthusiastic, professional, warm, or energetic

- Generates a talking avatar video synchronized to the uploaded audio
- Preserves the overall identity and composition of the source image
- Includes lip-sync, facial animation, and subtle motion rather than full-body cinematic action
- Usually works best for presenter-style, dialogue-style, or direct-to-camera content
- Final duration normally matches the audio track length
- Best suited to scenarios where clarity, expression, and consistency matter more than dramatic scene changes

- Start with a clean portrait that has clear eyes, mouth, and facial contours
- Prefer front-facing framing over extreme side profiles
- Use a single speaker with low-noise audio for the most reliable sync
- Keep prompts short so they guide style without conflicting with the audio-driven performance
- Test with a shorter clip first before generating longer videos
- Reuse the same portrait across versions if you need identity consistency across multiple outputs
- For production workflows, standardize image framing and audio quality across all jobs

KlingAI Avatar 2.0 Standard is a practical audio-to-avatar generation model for teams that want consistent talking-head video output from minimal inputs. It balances quality, speed, and cost by using a single image plus spoken audio to create synchronized, expressive avatar videos that are suitable for tutorials, explainers, announcements, and conversational content.

Provider: KlingAI
Model AIR ID: klingai:avatar@2.0-standard
Workflow: image-to-video with audio
Typical integration notes:
- Required image input
- Required audio input
- Optional positive prompt
- Common provider limits include input constraints for image dimensions, aspect ratio, audio duration, and file size

Docs:
https://runware.ai/docs/en/providers/klingai
Model page:
https://runware.ai/models/klingai-avatar-2-0-standard
